description: Unified education data standards graph — CEDS, SIF, Ed-Fi, PESC, CTDL, SEDM, JEDx, EdMatrix, CIP with cross-standard mappings, codeset comparison, and semantic search across all standards
_note: No startup needed. Docker --restart unless-stopped keeps containers running. First-time init: indexDataModelExplorer -start --assetsDir=./assets

definition.name: dme_search
definition.description: Semantic vector search across ALL standards in the unified graph (the live inventory comes from dme_list_standards). Vector-only — the graph carries a single vector index on :ForgedNode(embedding) and no fulltext/BM25 index. Returns results ranked by cosine relevance. Accepts optional --standard parameter to scope to a single standard.

query.description: Natural language search query — concept name, field description, or question about education data elements

standard.description: Optional: limit results to a specific standard (CEDS, SIF, EdFi, PESC, CTDL, SEDM, JEDx, EdMatrix, CIP)

definition.name: dme_graph_retriever
definition.description: Semantic search with graph context enrichment. Finds similar nodes by meaning, then traverses graph relationships to return surrounding context including cross-standard mappings, types, codesets, and reference networks. Use when you need to understand how a result connects to the rest of the data model.

query.description: Natural language description of what to search for

traversalMode.description: static: use pre-defined traversal (fast, free). dynamic: generate traversal Cypher specific to this query (slower, costs one LLM call, potentially richer).

searchMode.description: hybrid: BM25 + vector (default when both indexes exist). vector: vector similarity only. bm25: full-text only.

definition.name: dme_explore
definition.description: Show a specific node by name with all its properties and relationships. Returns the node's data plus all incoming and outgoing edges. Accepts optional --standard parameter to scope to a specific standard (CEDS, SIF, EdFi, PESC, CTDL, SEDM, JEDx, EdMatrix, CIP).

name.description: The exact name of the node to explore

standard.description: Optional: limit to a specific standard (CEDS, SIF, EdFi, PESC, CTDL, SEDM, JEDx, EdMatrix, CIP)

definition.name: dme_find_mappings
definition.description: Given an element from any standard, return the CEDS concept it maps to and its cross-standard equivalents. Each element resolves to a CEDS tuple — a HubReference, the canonical CEDS address — via EXACT_MATCH (authored crosswalk) or CLOSE_MATCH (inferred, carries a confidence score). Elements from different standards that resolve to the SAME HubReference form a shared-hub pair, labeled CONSERVATIVELY: direction 'equivalent' ONLY when BOTH hops are EXACT_MATCH (established, authored); 'candidateEquivalent' when either hop is CLOSE_MATCH (an inferred hypothesis — present it as such, never as established equivalence). Directions: 'outgoing' = this element's CEDS concept; 'equivalent'/'candidateEquivalent' = other standards' elements on the same concept; 'incoming' = when given a CEDS name, the source elements that map to it. Shared-hub rows carry BOTH hops' evidence: mappingType/confidence/matchPredicate = the other element's hop, viaMatchType/viaConfidence/viaPredicate = the queried element's own hop; no combined score is computed — judge from both. Every row includes the decomposed CEDS tuple (cedsTuple: domain · property · range [· value] + canonicalKey). Accepts an element name, XPath, _id, or CEDS property name/ID. CLASSIFICATION_CROSSWALK edges are deliberately excluded from this tool's equivalence results: a crosswalk correspondence is not a mapping.

name.description: SIF field name, XPath, CEDS property name, or CEDS ID (e.g., 'BirthDate', '/StudentPersonals/StudentPersonal/Name/FirstName', 'P600559')

definition.name: dme_compare_codesets
definition.description: Compare a codeset's allowed values across standards via the equivalence model: each source option value resolves to a value-tier CEDS hub; values from other standards on the same hub are its cross-standard equivalents. Returns one row PER VALUE — sourceValue, matchType (EXACT_MATCH / CLOSE_MATCH / null when unmatched), confidence, the CEDS value and key, and the cross-standard equivalent list. Unmatched values (matchType null) show where a codeset does not align to CEDS. It does NOT compute alignment types or coverage percentages.

name.description: Concept name to compare codesets for (e.g., 'grade', 'sex', 'state')

definition.name: dme_unmapped_fields
definition.description: List SIF fields that have no CEDS mapping — neither spec-annotated nor embedding-inferred. The annotation backlog. Shows object name, field name, xpath, and description.

definition.name: dme_stats
definition.description: Whole-graph statistics across ALL loaded standards: node counts by standard (_source), node counts by universal-contract role, EXACT_MATCH/CLOSE_MATCH equivalence-edge counts, and property-tier mapping coverage. For the per-standard registry list, use dme_list_standards.

definition.name: dme_list_standards
definition.description: Inventory of every standard loaded in the graph. Reads the :DmeStandardRoot passport nodes and returns each standard's source, name, standardName, description, version, sourceUrl, and live nodeCount. Use this for any 'what standards are loaded?' question — it never goes stale as new standards are forged in.

definition.name: dme_describe_graph
definition.description: The graph's self-description card: what this graph IS, how it was built, from what, and what it can do — read entirely from in-graph self-documentation nodes. Returns the enriched :GraphProvenance passport (build facts, capability flags, per-standard breakdown, human description), the :ManifestRecipe + :RecipeBlock recipe (every content-addressed block the graph was replayed from, with versions and purposes), the manifest ancestry (BASED_ON lineage), and one :StandardDefinition per standard (display name, version + versionSource, source format, element counts, mapping disposition authored/inferred/island). Includes a pre-rendered human 'card' field. Use this FIRST for any 'what is this graph / how was it built / what version of X is loaded?' question. Degrades honestly on graphs built before self-documentation (says what is absent). Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum recipe blocks to include in the card (default 200; truncation is reported)

definition.name: dme_raw_cypher
definition.description: Execute raw Cypher against the unified graph. All nodes are :ForgedNode with a _source property indicating the standard (e.g. CEDS, EdFi, LIF); the inventory grows over time, so read _source rather than assuming a fixed list. Cross-standard equivalence: a source :ForgedNode connects via EXACT_MATCH (authored) or CLOSE_MATCH (inferred; carries confidence + predicate) to a :HubReference — the canonical CEDS tuple, keyed by canonicalKey. A HubReference decomposes to its CEDS leaves via HAS_CEDS_DOMAIN, HAS_CEDS_PROPERTY, HAS_CEDS_RANGE, HAS_CEDS_VALUE, HAS_CEDS_QUALIFIER. Two source elements are equivalent when they resolve to the same HubReference. SOC and CIP are additionally linked by CLASSIFICATION_CROSSWALK edges (NCES crosswalk; spec-authoritative; NOT equivalence — never compose them with EXACT_MATCH/CLOSE_MATCH hub resolutions).

definition.name: dme_history
definition.description: Show graph build history — timestamped events for every load, embed, bridge, and export operation across all standards. Accepts optional --standard filter and --limit (default 20).

standard.description: Optional: show history for a specific standard only

limit.description: Maximum number of history events to return (default 20)
